context: A police officer briefs a corp manager
purpose: Teach: 年度末/社債/付け加える/構える/済ませる/終日/折っ/心がける

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 年度末、防犯活動、強化期間です。
lines.en: We're in the year-end crime prevention strengthening period.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Calm authority without warmth. Steady pace, slight weight on 「強化期間」. The tone of someone delivering routine procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社債詐欺の手口、参考になりました。
lines.en: Yes. The corporate bond fraud methods you outlined were very helpful.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful. Slight nod in the voice. Acknowledging both the information and the officer's authority. Clear and earnest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 注意喚起、防犯ポスターに、新事例を付け加える予定です。
lines.en: We'll be adding new case examples to the crime prevention posters for heightened awareness.
lines.style: Professional clarity. Matter-of-fact delivery of procedure. Slight emphasis on 「新事例」 — the concrete action step. No flourish, no apology.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、警戒態勢を構える方針です。
lines.en: Understood. We're preparing an internal alert posture across the company.
lines.style: Formal but genuine commitment. Steady cadence. The register of someone in a professional meeting who takes the work seriously. Slight formality in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 現場調査、本日中に、済ませるよう、隊員に指示します。
lines.en: I'll instruct my team to complete the site survey before end of day.
lines.style: Decisive, directive. Light clip on 「指示」 — the moment of leadership. Rapid, efficient. No hesitation. The voice of someone giving orders they expect to be followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。終日、警察への協力体制、整えております。
lines.en: Yes. We have our cooperation framework with the police in place for the entire day.
lines.style: Formal deference. Slight pause before 「協力体制」 — showing he's prepared. Respectful, professional tone. The voice of a colleague confirming readiness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 書類、ここを折って、調書として保管します。
lines.en: I'll fold the documents here and file them as the official record.
lines.style: Practical instruction. Slight emphasis where he indicates physically — grounding the moment. Clinical, efficient. The tone of someone completing a task he's done many times.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民の安全、心がけるよう、社員にも周知します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the staff understands that public safety is our priority.
lines.style: Earnest closing commitment. Slight warmth breaking through the formality — this is about something that matters. Steady, clear, sincere. A small note of genuine concern beneath the professional register.
